description: Search the 340+ assets on 40+ chains that Shieldz Swap can route and return their exact asset ids. Use it when you are unsure of an id or which chains support a token (e.g. every chain that has USDC). Skip it for common native coins: get_quote and create_swap already accept shorthand like ZEC.ZEC or BTC.BTC. With no filters it also returns the list of chain codes. Read-only; the list is cached for 60 seconds.

chain.description: Exact chain code filter, e.g. ETH, BASE, ARB, OP, POL, BSC, SOL, BTC, ZEC, TRON, NEAR. Leave empty for all chains.

limit.description: Maximum assets to return (1-100, default 40). Verified assets come first.

search.description: Case-insensitive symbol or asset id fragment, e.g. "usdc", "zec", "0x8335".

name: list_assets

asset_id.description: Exact id to pass to get_quote / create_swap.

chain.description: Chain code, e.g. BASE, ETH, BTC, ZEC.

usd_price.description: Latest USD price as a decimal string, null if unknown.

verified.description: True when the contract is verified by CoinGecko, DefiLlama or CoinMarketCap.

warning.description: Present only for unverified assets: why to double-check the contract.

chains.description: All chain codes; only present when no filter was given.

total_matches.description: How many assets matched before the limit.

title: List swappable assets
